spacing_and_layout.philosophy: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense, data-heavy, every pixel utilized.

alignment.headers: left-aligned for text, right-aligned for numbers

surfaces.style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. No glassmorphism in this dashboard.
surfaces.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). No pills or large radii.
surfaces.shadows: None. Use 1px borders and distinct background colors for hierarchy.

buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 rounded-none

inputs.style: Sharp edges, flat backgrounds. Focus states are critical.

tables.header: bg-zinc-50 border-b-2 border-zinc-200 text-zinc-500 uppercase text-xs font-semibold

icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons (regular weight) for dense dashboard scannability. Minimal scale (16px - 20px).

motion_and_interactions.hover: Instant or very fast transitions (0.15s). Efficiency > Flourish.
motion_and_interactions.focus: Strong blue focus rings (2px) on all interactive elements.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use monospace ASCII loaders or sharp linear progress bars instead of spinning circles.

images.description: Abstract geometric minimal pattern with architectural precision in black, white, and grey. Used for the split-screen login page background to reinforce the enterprise/technical feel.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Text must be #09090B on #FFFFFF.
accessibility.focus_management: Visible focus states mandatory on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, user balances, confirmation text).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts `Chivo`, `IBM Plex Sans`, and `IBM Plex Mono` via Google Fonts in index.html or layout wrapper.
Override default Shadcn border-radius (`--radius`) to `0rem` or `0.125rem` (2px) globally in tailwind.config or index.css.
The layout should feature a sidebar navigation and a wide main content area. Use a 'Control Room' grid layout.
For the main 'Price Check' view, prioritize the search bar and the results table. The table should prominently highlight the row/cell with the lowest price (e.g., using the semantic success colors).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural containers to achieve the 'Grid Borders' look (visible 1px borders everywhere).
In the file upload area, use a drag-and-drop zone with a dashed border and monospace instructions.
Ensure the price history tracking view uses a clear line chart (Recharts) with sharp, no-curve lines (`type='linear'`).
Do NOT use transparent/glassmorphism surfaces. Everything must be solid for maximum readability.
